verdict.rationale: A managed ClickHouse service could plausibly ship an in-console AI SQL assistant, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack shows none. What it does document is adjacent and earns no credit here: an MCP server that lets external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) run SQL, CHKit for schema-as-code, and agent branching/isolation. None of these is a built-in assistant that writes, fixes, or explains SQL from natural language inside the product.
